## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -1.35% | 1M: -9.45%) shows easing fear while credit proxies HYG (1W: -0.15% | 1M: -0.08%) BELOW TREND and LQD RECOVERY (1W: +0.09% | 1M: -0.20%) are mixed — two independent confirmations of a neutral/mixed state.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear easing: VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -1.35% | 1M: -9.45%) ↓ falling. Credit neutral/mixed: HYG (1W: -0.15% | 1M: -0.08%) BELOW TREND and LQD (1W: +0.09% | 1M: -0.20%) RECOVERY → neutral.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral: SPY RECOVERY (1W: +0.08% | 1M: -1.38%) vs TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -0.17% | 1M: -0.02%) shows no clear stocks-vs-bonds signal and dollar/curve inputs are neutral.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy and Tech showing strength: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.83% | 1M: +8.52%) and XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.30% | 1M: +0.83%); Consumer Discretionary and Industrials weakening: XLY BELOW TREND (1W: -1.86% | 1M: -6.02%) and XLI BELOW TREND (1W: -0.54% | 1M: -6.94%). Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**
US flat-to-recovering: SPY RECOVERY (1W: +0.08% | 1M: -1.38%); EM leadership: EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.56% | 1M: +5.08%) while China underperforms: FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -2.24% | 1M: -5.32%).

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation alive: IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.21% | 1M: +22.25%) and ARKK ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.78% | 1M: +5.12%); small caps IWM RECOVERY (1W: +0.02% | 1M: -3.11%) — selective risk-taking.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Commodity strength broad: BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.77% | 1M: +18.38%), USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.36% | 1M: +19.10%), CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.07% | 1M: +2.17%); precious metals also ABOVE TREND: GLD (1W: +1.66% | 1M: +0.20%) and SLV (1W: +4.83% | 1M: +2.21%).

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy leadership: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.83% | 1M: +8.52%) and BNO/USO ABOVE TREND; natural gas diverges and shows weakness: UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -4.63% | 1M: -0.49%).

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
Confirmed: Commodities and risk assets (BNO, USO, CPER, IBIT) ABOVE TREND across 1W/1M. Divergence: overall sector breadth only 4/11 sectors positive — narrow advance that tempers conviction.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to commodities/energy and selective growth/EM (XLE, BNO, CPER, EEM, IBIT) while reducing exposure to consumer discretionary and industrials (XLY, XLI) until breadth widens.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.83% | 1M: +8.52%), XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.30% | 1M: +0.83%). BEARISH: XLY BELOW TREND (1W: -1.86% | 1M: -6.02%), XLI BELOW TREND (1W: -0.54% | 1M: -6.94%).

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.77% | 1M: +18.38%), USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.36% | 1M: +19.10%), CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.07% | 1M: +2.17%). BEARISH: UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -4.63% | 1M: -0.49%), agricultural names showing short-term CORRECTION (CORN, SOYB, WEAT).

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 (fear threshold) — current VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -1.35% | 1M: -9.45%); HYG/LQD divergence (HYG BELOW TREND 1W: -0.15% | 1M: -0.08% vs LQD RECOVERY 1W: +0.09% | 1M: -0.20%); watch sector breadth flipping back above 7/11 for clearer risk-on.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive, mixed signals from VXX (falling) and credit (HYG/LQD neutral). Energy, commodities and selective growth/EM (XLE, BNO, CPER, IBIT, EEM) showing strength while consumer discretionary and industrials (XLY, XLI) show weakness — monitor breadth and credit for next directional cue.
